about.overview.heading: ABOUT HASNUR
about.overview.hero_description: A business group founded by H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB, a businessman born in Kalimantan, together with Hj. Nurhayati, and grown from a river-transport business since 1966.
about.overview.meta_description: An overview of Hasnur Group, a business group founded by H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB and Hj. Nurhayati since 1966.
about.overview.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group is a business group founded by a businessman born in Kalimantan, the late H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB, together with his wife the late Hj. Nurhayati, who started a river-transport business as the seed of Hasnur Group in 1966. HASNUR combines the names of H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB (HAS) and Hj. Nurhayati (NUR).
about.overview.paragraph_2: Starting from river transport, shipyards, and forestry, Hasnur Group's business has continued to grow into sectors including coal mining, roads and dedicated coal terminals, agribusiness, transportation, shipping, construction, a professional football club, mass media, and sports education. Beyond running its businesses, Hasnur Group is also active in social initiatives through Yayasan Hasnur Centre, which oversees several educational institutions from early childhood through higher education in South Kalimantan.
about.overview.paragraph_3: Along the way, Hasnur Group carried out business restructuring and adopted modern business management principles while continuing to uphold religious values and local wisdom. With more than 50 years of experience, Hasnur Group now has 6 integrated Strategic Business Units (SBUs): Forestry, Mining, Agribusiness, Services, Media, and Logistics.
about.overview.paragraph_4: The management team appointed holds a strong commitment that the company should grow not only for the benefit of shareholders and employees, but also for the advancement of the community, local and central government, and other stakeholders, both now and in the future. Hasnur Group continues its business activities with one purpose: "Grow Together Develop the Future" — growing and developing together to build the future.

csr.overview.heading: OVERVIEW
csr.overview.hero_description: Hasnur Group's commitment to keep contributing to the communities and environment around its areas of operation.
csr.overview.meta_description: Hasnur Group's corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs for the people of South and Central Kalimantan.
csr.overview.paragraph_1: As one of Indonesia's business players, Hasnur Group is committed to continuously contributing to sustainable development and to improving community welfare, particularly for the Banua people. This commitment aligns with Hasnur Group's motto, “Grow Together Develop The Future.” The motto reflects the aspiration of Hasnur Group's founders, the late H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB and the late Hj. Nurhayati, that the businesses Hasnur Group runs must be able to build up the region and improve the welfare of its people, particularly in South Kalimantan and Central Kalimantan.
csr.overview.paragraph_2: Hasnur Group's responsibility and concern for the community is channeled through its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program, approached through Community Development (CD). Programs are created based on community needs and carried out by the community itself. In other words, the community is the most important actor in participating in and making the company's social programs succeed, while the company's role is limited to providing support and encouragement to the community in making those social programs a success.
csr.overview.paragraph_3: Vision: Achieving harmony with stakeholders in improving community welfare and sustainable environmental preservation.
csr.overview.paragraph_4: Mission: • Opening community access to the company's presence through various empowerment programs to develop human resources • Building synergy with stakeholders to improve community welfare in the fields of religion, economy, socio-culture, education, health, and sustainable environmental preservation • Encouraging cooperation with stakeholders to create sustainable harmony between human development and the environment • Strengthening the company's legitimacy and positive image through community care
csr.overview.paragraph_5: Hasnur Group is committed to playing an active role in empowering communities to live better lives and in supporting government programs by driving development across several areas aligned with the SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals). The SDGs, comprising 17 Goals and 169 Targets, form a global action plan for the next 15 years (2016 to 2030) aimed at ending poverty, reducing inequality, and protecting the environment. The SDGs apply universally, so every country, developed nations included, carries a moral obligation to achieve the SDG Goals and Targets.
csr.overview.paragraph_6: The noble aim of the SDGs is to achieve sustainable development for a better future, in line with the concept of CSR. Hasnur Group has developed a wide range of CSR program innovations for the benefit of the community, built on five pillars of development: the Economic Pillar, the Education Pillar, the Socio-Culture Pillar, the Health Pillar, and the Environment and Infrastructure Pillar, delivered through CSR programs together with its business entities.
csr.overview.paragraph_7: The Economic Pillar is a CSR program focused on improving the economic standard of living of families within the ring-1 villages of Hasnur Group's business entities. According to South Kalimantan's Central Statistics Agency (BPS), as of March 2019 the number of people living in poverty in South Kalimantan stood at 192.48 thousand, a poverty rate of 4.55 percent, while Central Kalimantan stood at 134,594 people (4.98 percent). These figures serve as a reference for the company to remain aware of the socio-economic conditions of the surrounding community. Through the company's contributions to nearby communities, it is hoped that community welfare will rise, enabling them to meet their daily family needs, whether primary, secondary, or tertiary.
csr.overview.paragraph_8: The Socio-Culture Pillar is a CSR program focused on preserving existing cultural values and local wisdom, safeguarding local customs and traditions, and protecting the historical heritage found within nearby communities. It should be noted that Hasnur Group's business entities live side by side with local communities from the Banjar and Dayak ethnic groups, both native to the provinces of South Kalimantan and Central Kalimantan, each carrying a diversity of values and culture relative to other ethnic groups. As an expression of care for the communities it lives alongside, Hasnur Group therefore develops CD programs centered on socio-cultural preservation.
csr.overview.paragraph_9: The Education Pillar is a CSR program focused on raising education levels and the quality of human resources among local communities. South Kalimantan's Central Statistics Agency (BPS) records that the majority of South Kalimantan's population has completed junior secondary school (SMP), at a rate of 89.66%. While the company is not the primary actor in raising local education levels, it seeks to act as one of the government's stakeholders in doing so. With the company's continued support for education, it is hoped that the quality of Banua's human resources will keep improving and help advance the region.
csr.overview.paragraph_10: The Environment Pillar is a CSR program focused on preserving environmental sustainability. The company recognizes that protecting the environment is a shared obligation, carried out in the hope of contributing to sustainable living for generations to come. Whether we realize it or not, it is future generations who will inherit and live in this environment, and so the obligation to keep it healthy and sustainable is meant to be felt by both the generation living today and generations yet to come.
csr.overview.paragraph_11: The Health Pillar is a program focused on improving maternal and child health, as well as the health of communities around the company's areas of operation. Health, of course, is not the government's responsibility alone. In this regard, Hasnur Group continues to work together with the government, in this case the relevant Regional Government Work Units (SKPD), to address health issues so that communities can look forward to a healthy and decent life.

she.overview.hero_description: The SHE Directorate works to minimize workplace accidents and to protect safety, health, and the environment across every business unit.

she.overview.logo_2: A red curved field, symbolizing all of the company's business activities constantly advancing and growing
she.overview.logo_3: A leaf with a yellow vein and a green arrow tip, symbolizing an OHSE culture and sustained prosperity as the company continues to operate.

she.overview.meta_description: Hasnur Group's Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) Directorate.
she.overview.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group's SHE Directorate works to help minimize workplace accidents, losses or damage to equipment, and environmental harm. The SHE Directorate supports each entity/company in upholding the Vision and Mission of becoming a company that cares for the environment and the community, in the ongoing management of natural resources.
she.overview.paragraph_2: The company's commitment to Occupational Safety, Health and Environmental aspects is clearly set out in the Occupational Health, Safety and Environmental Preservation Policy (K3L), signed by the President Director of Hasnur Group, serving as a mandatory reference for all Management and Employees in achieving the company's performance goals.
she.overview.paragraph_3: In carrying out its business and operations across its Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and business entities, Hasnur Group remains committed to complying with applicable laws and regulations and continually strives to achieve better targets in Occupational Safety, Health and Environmental aspects.
she.overview.paragraph_4: AMDAL (Environmental Impact Analysis) and UKL-UPL (Environmental Management and Monitoring Efforts) are environmental management instruments required for every company business and a condition for obtaining an Environmental Permit from the Government. Every company business and/or activity must also undergo an OHS assessment and a review of its impact on the living environment.
she.overview.paragraph_5: In its mining operations the company applies the concept of Good Mining Practice, applies sustainability principles in forestry management, and applies sustainability aspects to its agribusiness operations as well as its other businesses.
she.overview.paragraph_6: Through sustained, well-executed performance, the company has achieved a number of recognitions, including a PROPER Blue rating, an International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001 Certificate, an ISO 14001 Certificate, an ISO 45001 Certificate, a Mining Safety Management System (SMKP) Certificate, an Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO) Certificate, an International Code for the Security of Ships and Port Facilities (ISPS Code) Certificate, and a Zero Accident Award from the government.

business.logistic.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group developed the Logistics Strategic Business Unit (SBU) to support businesses within the Hasnur Group as well as other business partners.
business.logistic.paragraph_2: PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk (HIS) operates in commodity logistics and transportation by river and sea, serving both the domestic market and the wider Asian region. HIS currently operates 14 sets of tugboats and barges with varying capacities, ranging from 7,500 metric tons (MT) to 10,000 MT. With an annual carrying capacity reaching 10 million MT, HIS provides transport services for a range of commodities from loading port to discharge port, both domestically and internationally, with a focus on operational excellence, safety, punctuality, and efficiency.
business.logistic.paragraph_3: As part of Hasnur Group Indonesia's Logistics SBU, HIS has two subsidiaries: PT Hasnur Resources Terminal (HRT) and PT Hasnur Mitra Sarana (HMS). HRT operates in terminal and port facility management. HRT holds a Port Business Entity license covering nine lines of business, namely:
business.agribusiness.hero_description: Starting from log-rafting services on the Barito watershed, now spanning plantation and forestry businesses.
business.agribusiness.meta_description: Hasnur Group's Agribusiness & Forestry SBU, covering forestry and oil palm plantations.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group has substantial experience in forestry and plantation businesses. It began with log-rafting services along the Barito watershed, before growing to hold its own forest concession areas (the term HPH has since changed to Forest Utilization Business Licensing – PBPH) through PT Barito Putera, PT Hasnur Jaya Utama, and PT Nusantara Alam Raya Sejahtera. In plantations, Hasnur Group holds an oil palm plantation portfolio through its subsidiaries PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu and PT Barito Putera Plantation.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_2: In running its business, PT Barito Putera holds a Natural Forest Timber Utilization Business License (IUPHHK-HA) covering an area of 42,065 hectares, located in Barito Utara Regency (Sei Lahei Forest Group) and Murung Raya Regency (Sungai Laung Forest Group), Central Kalimantan Province. Likewise, PT Hasnur Jaya Utama holds a Natural Forest Timber Utilization Business License (IUPHHK-HA) covering an area of 30,825 hectares, located in Barito Selatan Regency and Barito Timur Regency, Central Kalimantan Province.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_3: PT Nusantara Alam Raya Sejahtera (NAS) subsequently expanded the Forestry SBU into four PBPH concession activities covering 133,040 hectares. NAS's own concession also happens to be located in Murung Raya Regency. All four PBPH locations use the Barito watershed for log rafting and transport all the way to Banjarmasin. An integrated business development effort together with PT Wana Agro Selaras (WAS) and PT Barito Putera Industri (BPI) now forms an Integrated Forestry Business scheme comprising the forest concession at PT NAS, the contractor role at PT WAS, and the veneer industry at PT BPI, with optimal forest resource management aimed at adding value and ensuring the business remains sustainable.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_4: In running its operations, Hasnur Group continually strengthens the participation and contribution of communities around its forest areas, who are committed to preserving the environment and forest resources sustainably. The integrated business development together with PT Wana Agro Selaras (WAS) and PT Barito Putera Industri (BPI) forms an Integrated Forestry Business scheme comprising the forest concession at PT NAS, the contractor role at PT WAS, and the veneer industry at PT BPI. Optimal forest resource management is believed to add value appropriately so the forestry business can run sustainably.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_5: In the plantation sector, PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu holds an oil palm plantation area of 9,652 hectares located in Tapin Regency, South Kalimantan, while PT Barito Putera Plantation holds an oil palm plantation area of 13,006 hectares located in Barito Kuala Regency, South Kalimantan. In developing their plantations, PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu and PT Barito Putera Plantation apply cultivation techniques suited to the local ecosystem, and have successfully greened underused, low-productivity land. Besides land transport, both companies also use water transport, helping preserve the surrounding ecosystem and environment.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_6: In 2012, the Governor of South Kalimantan presented PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu with an award of recognition for carrying out the Oil Palm Plantation Development Partnership Program in South Kalimantan in accordance with Ministerial Regulation No. 26/2007, as an implementation of a plantation company's obligation to improve the welfare of communities around its plantations.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_7: PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu has grown into a well-regarded oil palm plantation company in the South Kalimantan region, and in February 2013 inaugurated its first crude palm oil (CPO) mill in Tapin Regency, South Kalimantan. The CPO mill has a production capacity of 45 tons of fresh fruit bunches (FFB) per hour, which can be increased to 90 tons of FFB per hour.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_8: PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu also received its Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO) certification in 2016, and remains fully committed to upholding ISPO principles and criteria for sustainable palm oil production.
business.agribusiness.paragraph_9: PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu and PT Barito Putera Plantation remain open to collaborating with other parties, including on utilizing waste from palm oil production, whether for renewable energy or other uses of significant benefit to the community. In running its business, Hasnur Group's oil palm plantation operations also prioritize sustainable community empowerment as an expression of the company's care for the environment around its operations. PT Hasnur Citra Terpadu and PT Barito Putera Plantation are committed to building the future and growing together with the community.
business.energy.hero_description: The Energy SBU oversees a sub-holding in mining with production capacity that keeps growing.
business.energy.meta_description: Hasnur Group's Energy SBU, covering coal mining and micro-hydro power generation.
business.energy.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group's Energy SBU has developed a Strategic Business Unit that oversees a sub-holding in mining and micro-hydro power plants (PTMH). In mining, Hasnur Group holds a vision of becoming a leading mining company in Indonesia, with production capacity that keeps rising year on year to meet national and international coal demand.
business.energy.paragraph_2: Hasnur Group's coal mining business is currently managed by two subsidiaries: PT Energi Batubara Lestari, which holds a mining business license area of 1,896 hectares, and PT Bhumi Rantau Energi, which holds a mining business license area of 2,096 hectares, both located in Rantau, Tapin Regency, South Kalimantan. PT Energi Batubara Lestari and PT Bhumi Rantau Energi are experienced in serving both national and international markets, including Thailand, China, India, Chile, and Slovenia, among others.
business.energy.paragraph_3: Mining activities are carried out by applying Good Mining Practices and complying with applicable government regulations, including proper environmental management and business sustainability. Beyond continually improving productivity, Hasnur Group is committed to environmental preservation. Procedures, systems, and monitoring programs are carried out regularly and continuously to keep the ecosystem's balance under control.
business.energy.paragraph_4: PLTM Bayang Nyalo is an embodiment of Hasnur Group's effort to harness new and renewable energy (EBT) through its business entity PT Bayang Nyalo Hidro (BNH). This renewable power plant uses water as its driving force, harnessing head height and water flow. Its main power-generating equipment, the turbines and generators, are manufactured in Austria by Voith Hydro Austria, one of the world's leading hydro turbine manufacturers. The relationship between BNH and Voith Hydro Austria in supplying that equipment came through cooperation between BNH and Voith Fuji Services (Japan) under the Japan–Indonesia Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM) program.
business.energy.paragraph_5: PLTM Bayang Nyalo, with a capacity of 6 MW, will generate 52.56 GWh of electrical energy per year. Beyond providing a sustainable energy source, PLTM Bayang Nyalo also supports energy diversification — an important step in balancing energy needs with environmental preservation, contributing to a reduction in CO2 emissions of 32.53–41.73 thousand tons per year. That reduction in carbon emissions is equivalent to cutting the use of 11.46–14.7 million liters of diesel fuel, or 13.44–17.24 thousand tons of coal, per year.

All of PT Hasnur Cipta Karya's operations are carried out professionally, grounded in Hasnur Group's Seven Core Values.
business.technology.paragraph_2: PT Hasnur Informasi Teknologi is an IT consulting company founded on ideas and creativity in providing solutions, development, and implementation of information and communication technology. PT Hasnur Informasi Teknologi delivers high-quality, high-value services in solving the problems faced by its clients, offering software development, hardware installation and configuration, consulting, and a training center in information and communication technology to maximize client productivity and profitability, with a scope of work covering:
business.technology.paragraph_3: Through professional management, PT Hasnur Informasi Teknologi is committed to becoming a trusted strategic partner in information and communication technology with an international reputation.
business.technology.paragraph_4: PT Magma Sigma Utama (MSU), a subsidiary of Hasnur Group, runs end-to-end logistics for mining, agroforestry, energy, and oil and gas: transportation and trucking services, spare parts trading, 4th Party Logistics project management, and other supporting logistics services. PT MSU currently has two subsidiaries, PT Sinergi Sigra Sejahtera (PT SSS) and PT Mitra Sigra Utama (PT MSU), with projects spread across Kalimantan, Sulawesi, and Sumatra. These projects include coal transportation and trucking services in South Kalimantan with a capacity of at least 2 million tons per year, and diesel transportation of 35 million liters per year, as well as building logistics infrastructure for limestone mining in North Morowali and mobilizing 1,500–2,000 HP oil rigs from Sidoarjo to Ponorogo in East Java and from Prabumulih in South Sumatra to Tonga in North Sumatra.
business.technology.paragraph_5: PT MSU is determined to deliver the best service at premium quality to win markets outside the group and support the group's internal business growth, under the motto “A Trustworthy Partner.” To achieve this, PT MSU continuously and consistently carries out:
business.technology.paragraph_6: Hasnur Group also has a subsidiary running a mining contractor services business, (https://hasnurriungsinergi.co.id/). PT Hasnur Riung Sinergi has continued working to support economic growth by contributing positively to the nation since 2011, operating across the IUP of PT Energi Batubara Lestari, the IUP of PT Bhumi Rantau Energi, and the (PKP2B) of PT Antang Gunung Meratus, located in Tapin Regency, South Kalimantan. Our performance over the past year reached 66.5 million OB (BCM) and 11.8 million tons of coal (MT), supported by a workforce of 3,500 employees.
business.technology.paragraph_7: In its operations, the company believes safety improves quality of life and gives the company a competitive edge, and so is committed to implementing and developing the Hasnur Riung Sinergi Integrated Management System (HIMS), which functions as a system referencing both international requirements (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001) and national requirements (SMK3 and SMKP), as well as the internal and external issues relevant to the company's operations.
business.technology.paragraph_8: PT Hasnur Riung Sinergi also has subsidiaries: PT Fajar Anugerah Dinamika, a business unit in mining service contracting, and PT Sigma Rekayasa Prima, a business unit offering fabrication design services for the mining, heavy equipment, and maritime industries. We continually create safe, reliable, and environmentally friendly operations to achieve Operational Excellence.
business.technology.paragraph_9: PT Hasnur Cipta Karya is a limited liability company under Hasnur Group committed to becoming an independent, leading company in Engineering-Procurement-Construction (EPC), Construction Management, and construction materials supply across Kalimantan in particular and Indonesia in general, prioritizing quality assurance, on-time completion, and reasonable budgets, to deliver benefit for its stakeholders.

business.education.paragraph_10: Codero is committed to making a positive impact on education by providing the insight and skills that prepare children for a future full of technology. Under the tagline "Building Future Innovators in Coding & Robotic," Codero continues striving to create a creative, competitive next generation ready to face change in the digital era.
business.education.paragraph_11: PT Inovasi Ekosistem Pendidikan, an entity within Hasnur Group's Education SBU, has developed an LMS (Learning Management System) platform to improve teacher competency, focused on providing high-quality, easy-to-use teacher training services for the people of Indonesia. PT Inovasi Ekosistem Pendidikan has two flagship products: Guru Inovatif (https://guruinovatif.id) and Kampus Inovatif (https://kampusinovatif.id). Guru Inovatif offers a wide range of teacher training, from digital skills training to teaching and leadership training, delivered as online courses, online and offline events, and workshops.
business.education.paragraph_12: PT Inovasi Ekosistem Pendidikan also provides a range of learning support resources such as learning modules, learning media, articles, and learning videos. Besides Guru Inovatif, PT Inovasi Ekosistem Pendidikan also runs Kampus Inovatif, aimed at raising the quality and academic standing of university students in Indonesia through practitioner-led teaching, learning programs, KI Goes to Kampus, and digital content.
business.education.paragraph_13: PT Inovasi Ekosistem Pendidikan, based in Yogyakarta, has extensive experience partnering with a range of public and private universities in Indonesia, including Universitas Nahdhatul Ulama, Sarjanawiyata Tamansiswa, Universitas Negeri Malang, Universitas Negeri Jakarta, and many other universities that have partnered with PT Inovasi Ekosistem Pendidikan.
business.education.paragraph_14: PT Cipta Daya Inovasi is a startup company oriented toward developing digital innovations to address a range of problems in society. As part of Hasnur Group's Education SBU, PT Cipta Daya Inovasi is currently developing its newest product, Hulu Talent (HR software), specifically focused on a Performance Management System (PMS) built to manage employee or company performance to achieve set goals.
business.education.paragraph_15: This Performance Management System aims to maximize performance, deliver effective feedback, strengthen two-way communication, and drive employee or company growth and development. It also helps identify performance issues, and set policies for pay raises, compensation, or promotion, while shaping a positive, productive work culture.
business.education.paragraph_16: Hulu Talent offers a range of flagship features, including an Employee Database, Key Performance Indicators, Hierarchy, Talent Mapping, Assessment, Project Management, a Humanity Approach, 9 Boxes, and an Artificial Intelligence Approach.
business.education.paragraph_17: The offices of PT Cipta Daya Inovasi and Hulu Talent are located in Banjarmasin, across two separate offices. The first office is at GIBS, Jl. Trans Kalimantan, Sungai Lumbah, Alalak, Barito Kuala, South Kalimantan, Indonesia 70582. The second office is located at Wetland Square, Jl. A. Yani No. KM 3.5, Kebun Bunga, East Banjarmasin District, Banjarmasin City, South Kalimantan 70237.
business.education.paragraph_2: PT Insan Pendidikan Indonesia (PT IPI) is a company that provides educational facility services, educational buildings, and building rentals for educational purposes. As an educational facility service provider, PT IPI is committed to advancing education by creating student-friendly educational buildings with a range of facilities to support student learning, focused on early childhood (KB), kindergarten (TK), elementary school (SD), junior secondary school (SMP), and senior secondary school (SMA). PT IPI works to make a positive contribution to sustainable, efficient educational facility development across the country.
business.education.paragraph_3: PT IPI's lines of business include the following:
business.education.paragraph_4: Through Al-Hayyan Excellent School, PT IPI is committed to providing educational support buildings and quality educational facilities to raise the standard of education in Indonesia.
business.education.paragraph_5: CODERO, under PT Pengembangan Inovasi Pengajaran, is a Coding and Robotics training institute that fosters creativity, critical thinking, and technology mastery from an early age, through a range of programs that can be applied in schools' intracurricular and extracurricular activities as well as courses at Codero centers and representative offices.
business.education.paragraph_6: Codero currently has centers and representative offices in several cities, including Jakarta, South Tangerang, Banjarmasin, Yogyakarta, and Jayapura.
business.education.paragraph_7: Codero offers an innovative, world-class curriculum designed to stimulate the mind and enrich learning. Codero's current programs include:
business.education.paragraph_9: With a fun, interactive approach, Codero (www.codero.id) creates a learning environment that motivates children to grow and get to know the world of technology in a well-rounded way. The learning program spans multiple levels, from basic coding through to game application development, robotics, Arduino, and digital art. Codero also runs various events and competitions, such as the Cyber Code Competition and the Codero Roblox Championship, to test the skills children have gained and encourage a spirit of achievement.
business.consumer.hero_description: Overseeing businesses in media, lifestyle, and healthcare.
business.consumer.list_5: Store, Merchandise, and PS Barito Putera Heritage
business.consumer.meta_description: Hasnur Group's Consumer SBU, covering media, lifestyle, and healthcare businesses.
business.consumer.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group developed the Consumer strategic business unit, which oversees businesses in media, lifestyle, and healthcare.
business.consumer.paragraph_2: Hasnur Group's media business is managed by PT Hasnur Media Citra as a holding company overseeing several entities. The media business initially operated in newspaper and tabloid publishing as well as news and sports radio broadcasting in South Kalimantan.
business.consumer.paragraph_3: The business today is run primarily through PT Putera Barito Berbakti, which oversees the PS Barito Putera football club and the SOBP sports school. PS Barito Putera (short for Persatuan Sepakbola Barito Putera) is an Indonesian football club based in Banjarmasin, South Kalimantan. PS Barito Putera was founded on 21 April 1988 and has competed in Indonesia's top football league, Liga 1, since the 2013 season.
business.consumer.paragraph_4: SOBP is an institution that upholds children's rights during their growth and development, helping shape a fit, principled, faithful, and accomplished younger generation.
business.consumer.paragraph_5: As it grows, SOBP will always stay dynamic in developing itself to improve the quality of its services and education, producing a younger generation that lives up to our shared expectations. We will therefore continually develop, from pedagogy through to curriculum, so that SOBP can keep going and remain an important part of sports development in Indonesia.
business.consumer.paragraph_6: PT Hasnur Media Citra exists not only to develop business units within the Hasnur Group corporation, but also to safeguard the company's integrity, image, and brand amid an era of globalization and digital communication that is increasingly open and far-reaching, both domestically and internationally. PT Hasnur Media Citra's scope of services and business includes:
business.consumer.paragraph_7: In 2023, Hasnur Group began a new healthcare services business through its investment in PT Intibios Persada Sejahtera. Intibios is a holistic community health center providing health services from testing, consultation, and diagnostics through to medicine sales, via its laboratories, clinics, and pharmacies, for the people of Indonesia. Intibios currently has 10 outlets spread across 7 major cities in Indonesia, including Jabodetabek, Bali, Bandung, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Surabaya, and Cirebon.
business.investment.hero_description: Supporting the development of the group's various businesses through internal and external investment.
business.investment.meta_description: Hasnur Group's Investment SBU, growing businesses through internal and external investment.
business.investment.paragraph_1: Through its Investment SBU, Hasnur Group continues to grow its various businesses with investment support, from entities within Hasnur Group as well as external partners.
legal.privacy.access_body_1: Your message is stored in the site's database and forwarded by email to a single official Hasnur Group address. Only site administrators with an admin panel account can read it. The data is not shared with any third party.
legal.privacy.access_body_2: This site does not install third-party analytics services, tracking pixels, embedded maps, or scripts from other domains. All images, fonts, and scripts are served from Hasnur Group's own domain, so your visit is not reported to any other provider.
legal.privacy.analytics_body_1: To understand which parts of the site visitors need, the site records four things on its own: which call-to-action buttons are clicked, which files are downloaded, which keywords are typed on the search page, and which articles are read through to the bottom. Each record stores only the event type, the name of that button or file or keyword, the page where it happened, and the page language.
legal.privacy.analytics_body_2: Your IP address and browser type are not stored. What is stored is only a short cryptographic hash of both together with that day's date: the value changes at midnight, cannot be reversed, and cannot be linked to the previous day's records. It serves one purpose — telling ten clicks from one person apart from ten clicks by ten people.
legal.privacy.analytics_body_3: These records use no cookies, are not used to identify you, are not combined with data from the Contact Us form, and are not sent to anyone outside this site's server. Records older than twelve months are deleted automatically.
legal.privacy.changes_body: If this policy changes, the latest version is published on this page. The date of the most recent change is noted below.
legal.privacy.collected_intro: This site collects data in one place only: the Contact Us form.
legal.privacy.collected_item_1: What you fill in yourself: name, email address, phone number if provided, subject, and message content.
legal.privacy.collected_item_2: What is recorded automatically: the sender's IP address and the language of the page open at the time of sending.
legal.privacy.collected_note: The IP address is recorded to limit repeated submissions and trace misuse of the form. Outside that form, browsing this site collects no personal data at all.
legal.privacy.controller_body: This site is managed by PT Hasnur Group, with its address at Office 8 Building, 7th Floor, Jl. Senopati No. 8B, South Jakarta 12190. [decision needed] The name and contact details of the data protection officer will be listed here.
legal.privacy.cookie_body: This site stores two technical cookies: a session identifier and a form security token. Both are required for the forms and admin pages to work, are not used to recognize you across visits, and there are no advertising cookies.
legal.privacy.draft_body: Sections marked [decision needed] are awaiting confirmation from management and legal counsel: the legal basis for processing, retention periods, and the data protection officer. The technical details outside those sections already reflect how the system works today.
legal.privacy.hero_description: What this site collects, what for, how long it is kept, and how you can exercise your rights.
legal.privacy.meta_description: An explanation of the personal data the Hasnur Group site collects, the purposes of processing, retention periods, and how to exercise your rights as a data subject.
legal.privacy.purpose_basis: [decision needed] The legal basis for processing under Article 20 of Law No. 27 of 2022 will be stated here.
legal.privacy.purpose_body: To answer the questions, information requests, or partnership proposals you send. Data from the form is not used to send promotional material and is not sold.
legal.privacy.purpose_heading: What the data is used for
legal.privacy.retention_body: [decision needed] The retention period for form messages will be stated here, along with when automatic deletion runs.
legal.privacy.rights_body: Under Law No. 27 of 2022 you have the right to request access to your data, request correction if it is inaccurate, request deletion, withdraw consent where consent is the basis for processing, and object to processing.
legal.privacy.rights_request_after: with the subject "Personal Data Request". We will respond to the email address you provide.
legal.privacy.security_body: Access to the admin panel requires an account and password, and passwords are stored as one-way hashes. Form submissions are limited to five times per ten minutes from a single IP address.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy

home.about.heading: Starting from the Barito River, 1966
home.about.paragraph_1: Hasnur Group was founded by H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB, a businessman born in Kalimantan, together with his wife Hj. Nurhayati, who started a river-transport business in 1966.
home.about.paragraph_2: The name "HASNUR" combines the initials of both founders: HAS (H. Abdussamad Sulaiman) + NUR (Nurhayati).

home.core_values.perseverance.descriptio: Always striving to give a full, thorough effort against every challenge, with the tenacity and resilience never to give up on turning any task into reality.
home.core_values.perseverance.name: Perseverance
home.core_values.togetherness.descriptio: Sharing a sense of common fate, looking out for one another, caring, paying attention, and reminding each other within a close family-like bond.

home.core_values.trustworthiness.descrip: Working wholeheartedly and honestly, upholding ethical and moral values, and being reliable for every stakeholder facing any assignment or challenge.

home.hero.quote: The founders' commitment, H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB and Hj. Nurhayati, to keep serving and building together with the people of South Kalimantan, the "Banua", remains the foundation of Hasnur Group's journey to this day.
home.hero.supporting: Celebrating 60 years of Hasnur Group's journey, with company values growing stronger as it moves toward a more sustainable future.
home.meta_description: Hasnur Group is a business group founded by H. Abdussamad Sulaiman HB and Hj. Nurhayati, entrepreneurs from Kalimantan. Grow Together Develop the Future.
home.timeline.1988: Founded the PS Barito Putera football club.
home.timeline.1992: Started mining and oil palm plantation operations.
home.timeline.2000: Acquired a coal hauling road and port in Tapin, South Kalimantan.
home.timeline.2009: Expanded oil palm plantations and seaborne coal transport.
home.timeline.2010: Founded Yayasan Hasnur Centre and added oil palm land in Barito Kuala.
home.timeline.2013: Inaugurated an oil palm mill in Tapin and a coal port in South Barito.
home.timeline.2020: Strengthened the logistics and renewable energy businesses.
home.timeline.2021: Subsidiary PT Hasnur International Shipping listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (ticker: HAIS), 1 September 2021.
home.timeline.2023: Restructured into 7 Strategic Business Units (SBUs): Logistic, Agro Forestry, Energy, Technology & Services, Education, Consumer, Investment.
